_comment: The roster. Every submission and every device bundle must name an owner
that appears here, and CI rejects the ones that do not.
A static site cannot authorise anybody: GitHub Pages serves files and has
no server to check a password against. So identity here is a GitHub
account, ownership is asserted in the bundle, and the check that actually
bites happens in CI, where the commit author is compared against the
declared owner. The 'sign in' control on the site is display
personalisation only and is labelled as such.
